product_summary: Real-time B2B data API suite covering 33M+ companies and 193M+ people: enrichment, search, lookalikes, headcount trends, reverse email lookup, bulk enrichment and an MCP server.

api_or_integration_evidence.quote: CompanyEnrich is a B2B data API that returns verified company and people information through a single REST interface.
connect AI agents to live data through our MCP server
Get 60+ data points, from firmographics to financials. 33M+ companies covered.

newsletter_capability_detail: Searched the homepage, Getting Started docs, Company Enrichment API product page and site for 'newsletter'. Documented sources are 'the public web, maps, social media, and government records'; the published field schema (industry, employees, revenue, keywords, technologies, financials, socials, NAICS, page_rank) contains no newsletter mention, publication or topic-momentum field.
verified_gap: Company activity fields stop at firmographics, tech stack, headcount, hiring and funding; there is no newsletter mention, publication or topic-momentum field, and newsletters are not among their named sources.

evidence.quote: Data sourced from the public web, maps, social media, and government records helps you find businesses other providers miss.
Returns industry, size, revenue range, location, technologies, employee count, and 15+ additional fields.
Get 60+ data points, from firmographics to financials. 33M+ companies covered.
Fields used: Industry, employee range, revenue range, business model categories, and funding stage.

likely_buyer_role: Co-founder/CTO or Head of Product (small founding team owns API roadmap and partnerships)
caveats: Absence is drawn from their own source description and public field schema, not a formal 'we do not ingest newsletters' statement; the free-text 'keywords' and 'description' fields are derived from web content and could partially capture newsletter-derived language. They ship fast (new Jobs API, MCP server), so a data-partnership pitch should target the founders directly.
